title: TS2Python wire v4 — tick
description: Payload emitted by EL_PublishTick. Frame 2 of a 2-frame ZMQ message; frame 1 is the UTF-8 symbol topic. See envelope.md and semantics.md — schema validation alone is NOT sufficient to implement a correct binding.

v.description: Wire version — the shape of this envelope. Decided by the DLL.

pv.description: Publisher convention version — which rules produced the NUMBERS, as opposed to v, which says where the fields are. Decided by the EasyLanguage indicator, which lives in the user's TradeStation install and does not update when the DLL or a binding does. 0 means undeclared (the plain EL_Init path, i.e. an exporter older than this field): read intraday vol as up-tick share volume alone, about half of what traded. 1 means semantics.md §3.4 is implemented — vol is total share volume on every timeframe and intraday tc is 0. An unknown value must be logged, never refused: the fields are still readable and the data is not damaged. See envelope.md.

seq.description: Per-symbol monotonic sequence, starting at 1. Shared with bar on the same symbol. A number is consumed even when the send that follows it fails, so a gap means data really was lost. Emitted as an unsigned 64-bit integer: parsers that decode JSON numbers as doubles must read this as an integer type or comparisons drift past 2^53. See semantics.md §6.

sid.description: Publisher session id — the UTC epoch MICROsecond stamped at init. A change means the publisher restarted and every seq reset, which is not message loss.

ts.description: DLL receive-side wall clock, UTC epoch seconds with sub-second precision. AUTHORITATIVE for tick event time. Must NOT be used for bar bucket alignment.

ts_utc.description: ts_str converted to UTC epoch by the DLL via std::chrono::zoned_time("America/New_York"). 0.0 when el_timestamp was absent or unparseable. Cross-check only — never authoritative.

ts_str.description: Raw EL timestamp, format yyyy-MM/dd-HH:mm:ss (24-hour), passed through verbatim. Empty string when EL supplied none. NOT JSON-escaped by the publisher.

vol.description: Total share volume — but only when pv >= 1. At pv 0 this is up-tick share volume alone. Emitted as a double (%.6f) even though semantically integral. Meaningless for index/breadth symbols. See semantics.md §3.4.

bid.description: Bid, or null when no quote is available. EL supplies 0 from InsideBid during historical replay and for symbols that carry no quote at all (breadth indices); the publisher normalises any non-positive value to null so the wire states the absence rather than leaving every binding to remember that 0 means "absent". See semantics.md §3.

ask.description: Ask, or null when no quote is available. Same rule as bid.

tc.description: NOT a trade count on an intraday tick — EasyLanguage exposes no such word, so a pv 1 publisher sends 0 here. Emitted as %.0f. See semantics.md §3.4.
